_comment: Owner: devops-engineer (P1-F02-T08). Non-secret config for the two Cloudflare Pages Free projects (D-008, D-031, tech note F02 section 7.5). Project names are config, not secrets: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID and CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN (GitHub Actions secrets only) are the only credentials involved.

client.name: keep-walking-preview
client.description: Client SPA (Vite + MapLibre GL JS). Created manually by HUMAN P1-F02-T17 (Direct Upload, empty index.html) and deployed for real by P1-F02-T19 via infra/scripts/publish-client.sh.

map.name: keep-walking-map
map.description: Tiles (XYZ + tiles.json), glyphs, sprites, font-faces. Auto-created on first deploy by infra/scripts/publish-tiles.sh via `wrangler pages project create` (same CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN scope as the client project, Account > Cloudflare Pages > Edit) -- HUMAN does not need to click Create for this one.

budget._comment: Same numbers as tools/tiles/config.json#budget (tech note F02 section 7.1, 7.4, checked 2026-09-23). Duplicated intentionally: this script must not depend on tools/tiles internals, only on its documented output contract (manifest.json, tiles.json, the XYZ directory).

githubPagesFallback._comment: Temporary fallback only (ToS: no commercial use, tech note 7.3 row d). Used when tools/tiles/bin/build.sh exits 3 (only the GitHub Pages PMTiles set is within budget). Cloudflare Cache-Control cannot be set here (fixed by GitHub Pages at `max-age=600`, tech note 7.1); CORS is `access-control-allow-origin: *` automatically, also per tech note 7.1 -- both values are recorded in the runbook, not set by this script.
